title: Homeland Security Made a Big Claim About Noncitizen Voting. Now It Can’t Prove It.
summary: The Department of Homeland Security told Nevada election officials that it identified 185 “potential” noncitizens on the state’s voter rolls, not the nearly 16,000 it claimed last month.
